column1: # Catalog of variables session-env can export to the whole login session
# default 1 means the group is installed when session-env install is given
# no groups. value is environment.d syntax (${VAR} and ${VAR:-default}
# expand; "$$" is a literal dollar sign); "-" copies the value fish exports
# at install time, so redirects config.fish already applies stay in one place.
# session-env writes each entry as NAME=${NAME:-value}, so a value already in
# the session wins; a value that references its own name (PATH) is left as
# is, and a copied "-" value is written as fish's resolved value.
